venue: The International Journal of Robotics Research
title: AnyNav: Visual neuro-symbolic friction learning for off-road navigation
screening_reason: Physics-grounded visual friction learning is evaluated with multiple four-wheeled vehicles for off-road navigation and sim-to-real transfer.

title: SanD-Planner: Sample-Efficient Diffusion Planner in B-Spline Space for Robust Local Navigation
screening_reason: Sample-efficient diffusion planning in B-spline space addresses safe local navigation in simulated and realistic 2D/3D settings.

title: TravSUITE: Traversability via Self-Supervised, Uncertainty-Aware IRL and Terrain Estimation
screening_reason: Self-supervised uncertainty-aware traversability mapping adapts navigation risk and includes physical off-road trials.

title: Time-Aggregated Connectivity Maintenance for Multi-Robot Networks
screening_reason: Time-aggregated connectivity permits temporary network disconnections with barrier-function reconnection control and experimental evaluation.

venue: The International Journal of Robotics Research
title: A ground robot dataset for multi-sensor navigation in diverse environments
screening_reason: A synchronized/calibrated ground-robot GNSS/IMU/camera/LiDAR dataset spans indoor and outdoor navigation conditions.

venue: The International Journal of Robotics Research
title: NavWareSet: A dataset of socially compliant and non-compliant robot navigation
screening_reason: A social-navigation dataset includes Jackal and HSR recordings with LiDAR, RGB-D, odometry and human annotations.

title: Capability-Aware Shared Hypernetworks for Flexible Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Coordination
screening_reason: Capability-conditioned policies address heterogeneous multirobot coordination with Robotarium hardware and JaxMARL evaluation.

title: ObjectReact: Learning Object-Relative Control for Visual Navigation
screening_reason: Object-relative visual navigation combines a topometric object map and controller with cross-embodiment indoor sim-to-real tests.

title: Wheeled Lab: Modern Sim2Real for Low-cost, Open-source Wheeled Robotics
screening_reason: An open Isaac Lab-to-RC-car stack directly addresses low-cost wheeled sim-to-real navigation, terrain traversal and drifting.

title: JaxRobotarium: Training and Deploying Multi-Robot Policies in 10 Minutes
screening_reason: JaxRobotarium links realistic dynamics and safety-aware multirobot policy training to hardware deployment across coordination scenarios.

title: GC-VLN: Instruction as Graph Constraints for Training-free Vision-and-Language Navigation
screening_reason: Graph constraints grounded in language instructions enable training-free continuous navigation and real-world evaluation.

title: Certifiably-Correct Mapping for Safe Navigation Despite Odometry Drift
screening_reason: Certified free-space mapping despite odometry drift enables collision avoidance by a real rover.

title: ROMAN: Open-Set Object Map Alignment for Robust View-Invariant Global Localization
screening_reason: Open-set object-map alignment supports view-invariant global localization and multirobot loop closures across forest, urban and indoor scenes.

venue: Annual Review of Control, Robotics, and Autonomous Systems
title: Local Maps Are All You Need: A Review of Topometric Teach and Repeat Navigation
screening_reason: Review directly connects local maps, GNSS-denied field navigation, sensors, and hardware reliability; useful navigation synthesis.

venue: Annual Review of Control, Robotics, and Autonomous Systems
title: Mixed Crowd Navigation: Perception, Interaction, Planning, and Control
screening_reason: Review integrates crowd perception, interaction models, prediction, planning, and control; directly relevant to socially aware navigation.

title: EVS-SLAM: a lightweight visual SLAM system for autonomous robots in dynamic environments
screening_reason: Embedded RGB-D/stereo SLAM removes dynamic observations and reports same-platform ablations plus onboard deployments; relevant to resource-limited mobile robots.

title: Large language models for multi-robot systems: a survey
screening_reason: Survey specifically covers LLM task allocation, motion planning, communication, and deployment limitations in multi-robot systems.

title: Multi-robot navigation in social mini-games: definitions, taxonomy, and algorithms
screening_reason: Navigation taxonomy focuses on doorways, hallways and intersections, clarifying safety and liveness evaluation for mobile robots.

title: PERSCO: Perceived safe control of mobile robots in human groups with active learning
screening_reason: Mobile-robot control learns speed and distance preferences using human feedback, with a 54-participant study of perceived safety.

title: Deadlock-free, safe, and decentralized multi-robot navigation in social mini-games via discrete-time control barrier functions
screening_reason: Decentralized control barrier functions address safety and deadlock in constrained navigation; physical F1/10, Jackal and Spot experiments are reported.

title: Fast k-connectivity restoration in multi-robot systems for robust communication maintenance: algorithmic and learning-based solutions
screening_reason: Graph and learned decentralized methods restore robot communication after failures, with explicit movement and connectivity metrics.

title: Humans as path-finders for mobile robots using teach-by-showing navigation
screening_reason: Camera and laser fusion track a human path-finder and generate continuous-curvature mobile-robot paths; experimental validation is reported.

title: Inverse reinforcement learning for autonomous navigation via differentiable semantic mapping and planning
screening_reason: Inverse learning couples semantic mapping, cost inference, and differentiable planning for navigation; evaluated in minigrid and CARLA, with simulation transfer limits.

title: TNES: terrain traversability mapping, navigation and excavation system for autonomous excavators on worksite
screening_reason: RGB/point-cloud traversability maps feed real excavator navigation over pits, hills and rocks; useful field-navigation system evidence despite platform differences.

title: LDG‐CSLAM: Multi‐Robot Collaborative SLAM Based on Curve Analysis, Normal Distribution, and Factor Graph Optimization
screening_reason: Collaborative LiDAR SLAM targets GPS-denied operation with communication-efficient descriptors, NDT mapping and factor-graph optimization.

title: ROLO‐SLAM: Rotation‐Optimized LiDAR‐Only SLAM in Uneven Terrain With Ground Vehicle
screening_reason: LiDAR-only ground-vehicle SLAM specifically addresses vertical drift and rotation errors on uneven terrain with multiscene experiments.

title: Real‐Time Monocular 2D Occupancy Grid Mapping for Autonomous Navigation of Ground Robots
screening_reason: Sparse visual-inertial mapping is converted into a lightweight navigable 2D occupancy grid, with real indoor tests and memory/runtime comparison.

title: MS‐SLAM: Memory‐Efficient Visual SLAM With Sliding Window Map Sparsification
screening_reason: Sliding-window map sparsification reduces visual-SLAM memory use while retaining tracking and loop closure; relevant to constrained onboard computers.

title: A robot operating system framework for using large language models in embodied AI
screening_reason: ROS integrates open-source LLM agents, actions/services, behavior execution and feedback; system-level task validation is directly relevant to this ROS project.

venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering
title: Distributed Cooperative Localization in Multi-Robot Systems With Dual-Channel Event-Triggered Communication
screening_reason: Event-triggered cooperative localization limits measurement and estimate communication; validated on TurtleBot3 and Ackermann vehicles.

venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering
title: Distributed MPC-Based Navigation for Robotic Swarm Systems Under Robot Failure
screening_reason: Distributed MPC maintains and restores swarm connectivity after a robot stops, while preserving collision avoidance; physical experiments are reported.

venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering
title: Hybrid State Space Modeling for Sequence-Based Robot Localization Under Challenging Environments
screening_reason: Sequence-based localization combines stable state-space temporal modeling and differential features under illumination, weather and seasonal changes.

venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering
title: Adaptive Multi-Robot Cooperative Localization Based on Distributed Consensus Learning of Unknown Process Noise Uncertainty
screening_reason: Distributed consensus estimates unknown process-noise covariance for 2D multi-robot localization; analyses, datasets and physical tests support relevance.

venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering
title: Nav-SCOPE: Swarm Robot Cooperative Perception and Coordinated Navigation
screening_reason: Lightweight decentralized observation sharing over unreliable networks supports cooperative perception and navigation, with real multi-robot experiments.

venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering
title: Socially Aware Robot Navigation Framework: Where and How to Approach People in Dynamic Social Environments
screening_reason: Social approaching-pose selection and goal-oriented timed elastic bands handle people and groups, with simulation and mobile-robot tests plus explicit limitations.

title: Computationally Efficient Predictive Learning Control for Wheeled Mobile Robots: An Offline Sampling Approach
screening_reason: Offline sampled predictive iterative learning targets repetitive wheeled-robot tracking with low computation, smooth commands and real-robot tests.

title: GefaODR: Online Adaptive Dynamic Point Cloud Removal Based on Grid Existence Frequency for Mobile Robot SLAM
screening_reason: Online dynamic-point removal combines ground segmentation and spatiotemporal grids to improve SLAM in dynamic scenes; real-platform evaluation is reported.

title: Edge Accelerated Robot Navigation With Collaborative Motion Planning
screening_reason: Edge-assisted planner switching jointly considers computation, communication and collision avoidance for low-cost distributed mobile robots.

title: InPTC: Integrated Planning and Tube-Following Control for Prescribed-Time Collision-Free Navigation of Wheeled Mobile Robots
screening_reason: Integrated path planning and tube tracking provide prescribed-time obstacle avoidance on a wheeled Mona robot; static convex obstacle assumptions are explicit.

title: Energy-Time Optimal Trajectory Tracking Control of Wheeled Mobile Robots
screening_reason: Lyapunov-stable tracking of energy-time optimal point-to-point maneuvers is evaluated over repeated Pioneer 3-DX trials.

title: Vision-Based Adaptive Trajectory Tracking Control of Wheeled Mobile Robot With Unknown Translational External Parameters
screening_reason: Adaptive visual trajectory tracking compensates unknown camera-to-robot translation, with stability proof and physical mobile-robot tests.

title: DLC-SLAM: A Robust LiDAR-SLAM System With Learning-Based Denoising and Loop Closure
screening_reason: Learning-based LiDAR denoising and loop closure target reflective urban materials and noisy clouds, with benchmark tests and open implementation.

title: Koopman-Operator-Based Robust Data-Driven Control for Wheeled Mobile Robots
screening_reason: Data-driven Koopman modeling, online disturbance compensation and sliding-mode control are tested on an omnidirectional mobile robot.
